avoid_supplements.name: Sodium supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Increased sodium intake increases renal lithium clearance, reducing therapeutic levels and efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid sodium supplements; maintain consistent dietary sodium intake

avoid_supplements.name: Diuretics (herbal: Juniper, Dandelion)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Diuretics reduce renal lithium clearance, leading to toxic accumulation
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid all diuretic supplements; consult prescriber before use

avoid_supplements.name: NSAIDs (including herbal: Willow bark, Meadowsweet)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: NSAIDs decrease renal lithium clearance by reducing glomerular filtration and prostaglandin-mediated renal blood flow
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid NSAIDs; use acetaminophen for pain/fever instead

avoid_supplements.name: ACE inhibitors and ARBs (herbal equivalents: Garlic)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: These agents reduce renal lithium clearance and increase serum levels
avoid_supplements.action: Monitor lithium levels closely if concurrent use unavoidable; coordinate with prescriber

avoid_supplements.name: Thiazide diuretics (herbal: Bumetanide-containing supplements)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Thiazides reduce lithium clearance and increase renal tubular reabsorption, causing toxicity
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid; inform prescriber of all diuretic use

caution_supplements.name: Caffeine
caution_supplements.mechanism: Caffeine increases lithium excretion; inconsistent intake may destabilize lithium levels
caution_supplements.action: Maintain consistent caffeine intake; avoid sudden changes

caution_supplements.name: Calcium supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: May slightly affect lithium absorption and renal handling
caution_supplements.action: Take at separate times from lithium; monitor for changes in efficacy

caution_supplements.name: Magnesium supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: May compete with lithium for renal reabsorption
caution_supplements.action: Space dosing 2+ hours apart; monitor lithium levels if high doses used

avoid_foods.name: High-sodium processed foods
avoid_foods.mechanism: Sodium competes with lithium for renal reabsorption, increasing clearance and reducing therapeutic effect
avoid_foods.action: Maintain low, consistent sodium diet; target <2g sodium daily

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit/Grapefruit juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: May alter lithium metabolism and increase absorption
avoid_foods.action: Avoid grapefruit products; choose alternative fruits

caution_foods.name: High-potassium foods (bananas, spinach, avocados)
caution_foods.mechanism: Potassium may affect lithium-sodium balance in renal tubules
caution_foods.action: Consume in moderation; maintain consistent intake; monitor serum lithium levels

caution_foods.name: Caffeine-containing beverages (coffee, tea, cola)
caution_foods.mechanism: Caffeine increases urinary lithium excretion; variable intake destabilizes levels
caution_foods.action: Maintain consistent daily caffeine intake; avoid sudden increases or decreases

caution_foods.name: Dehydrating foods (high sugar, high salt snacks)
caution_foods.mechanism: Dehydration concentrates lithium levels in blood and increases toxicity risk
caution_foods.action: Maintain consistent fluid intake (≥2L water daily); avoid excessive dehydration

monitoring_notes: Lithium has a narrow therapeutic window (0.6-1.2 mEq/L); serum levels must be monitored regularly, especially when dietary sodium or fluid intake changes. Maintain consistent daily patterns for sodium, potassium, caffeine, and fluid intake to prevent therapeutic fluctuations and toxicity.
